objective: Run the complete OBSERVE->...->LEARN loop on held-out cases and evaluate the ablations not already covered by a dedicated priority; then perform one complete system audit, fix genuine defects, and issue the final capability matrix and verdict.

new_ablations_this_priority.memory_on_vs_off: ON = one shared FailureMemoryStore across all 300 episodes (matches every other reported condition); OFF = a fresh pipeline (fresh FailureMemoryStore + fresh RecoveryCircuitBreaker) constructed per episode
new_ablations_this_priority.retry_on_vs_off: ON = unmodified AgentDecisionCalibrationProfile; OFF = RetryDisabledCalibrationProfile wrapper remaps both ANSWER and RETRY decisions to REVIEW (both labels reach the same planner path for AGENT_INCORRECT_ANSWER, so both must be blocked for a genuine ablation)
new_ablations_this_priority.predictor_on_vs_off: ON = real AgentUncertaintyPredictor (self-consistency agreement rate); OFF = NullUncertaintyPredictor returning a fixed, uninformative score of 0.5 for every episode

audit_findings.root_cause: deterministic off-by-epsilon: a pure CPU busy-loop workload's risk is ALWAYS exactly WEIGHT_ELAPSED_RATIO=0.30 (elapsed_ratio clips to 1.0, rss/anomaly are 0), giving fused_score=0.70 exactly; the test's abstain_threshold=0.7 sat exactly on that boundary and DecisionPolicy's ABSTAIN rule is a strict '<', so the scenario could never actually abstain as written, on any machine
audit_findings.fix: raised abstain_threshold to 0.75 in the test, with the exact derivation documented inline

audit_findings.root_cause: this evaluation machine has a real NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 GPU with a working nvidia-smi (confirmed via `nvidia-smi -L`), contradicting the 'gpu mode always fails, no GPU device in this sandbox' assumption these tests and the controlled_runtime.py module docstring were written against
audit_findings.fix: not modified -- correctly reflects real, differing hardware; not an implementation defect

audit_findings.root_cause: asserts AUC>0.55 for the cpu/timeout family on seeds=SplitSeeds(train=range(0,400), validation=range(2000,2100), test=range(4000,4100)); independently re-measuring this EXACT seed range with the unmodified train_and_persist_scope_router reproduces AUC~0.51 on this machine -- corroborates Phase 4.8's own finding (real subprocess-timing seed-range sensitivity) with completely independent evidence
audit_findings.fix: not modified -- loosening this assertion would be exactly the 'post-hoc threshold tuning against inconvenient results' the project's integrity rules forbid
